en.does_not_prove: Documents legitimately pass through several programs (for example a signing or form tool); this shows a change of tool, not who used it or why.
en.shows: The producer changes from “ReportLab PDF Library - (opensource)” in revision 1 to “Foxit PDF Editor Version 13.0.0” in revision 2.
en.title: Different software between revisions

en.does_not_prove: Metadata dates come from the clock of the computer that saved each revision and can be set freely; a wrong clock, a time-zone error or dates copied by an editor can cause this. It does not by itself show deliberate backdating.
en.shows: Revision 3 was appended to the file after revision 2, but its modification date (2026-03-03T14:15:00Z) is 1 d 3 h 0 min earlier than that of revision 2 (2026-03-04T17:15:00Z).
en.title: Revision dated before the previous one

en.does_not_prove: Editors are also used for legitimate tasks such as filling in, signing, rotating or compressing a document; the fingerprint shows which software saved the file, not what was changed.
en.shows: Revision 2 carries the fingerprint of a PDF editor: Foxit PDF Editor / PhantomPDF (metadata producer: “Foxit PDF Editor Version 13.0.0”).
en.title: PDF editor fingerprint

en.does_not_prove: Editing tools add fonts when a form is filled in, a stamp or comment is added or text is legitimately corrected; this shows that text was written in that revision, not that it falsifies the document.
en.shows: Font Courier-Bold first appears in revision 3 and is used by page content there.
en.title: Font added in a later revision

en.does_not_prove: Incremental saving is normal when a PDF is filled in, signed, annotated or re-saved by many programs; it does not show who changed the file or that a change was improper.
en.shows: The file contains 3 revisions: the original save plus later updates appended to the end of the file. Each earlier version can be extracted and compared.
en.title: Incremental updates

en.does_not_prove: Metadata dates are written by the editing software from the computer clock and can be set freely; the gap does not prove when the changes were really made or by whom.
en.shows: Revision 2 is dated 2 d 3 h 0 min after revision 1 (according to their modification dates).
en.title: Time gap between revisions

en.does_not_prove: Incremental updates are normal when forms are filled, documents are signed or comments are added. It does not show who made the change, when, or with what intent.
